title: Cue
description: C-lane proposal to A for packages/contracts. Semantic interpretation of one utterance, produced by services/worker/semantics/parser.py. A validated Cue is deterministic input to services/api/policy/director.decide(); it never contains camera choices or LLM chain-of-thought.

target_guest_ids.description: Roster ids only. Never invented names. Empty for role/none scope or unresolved references.

action.description: Model's proposal. Director may override; SHOW requires NOW + one target, WIDE requires NOW + multiple targets.

evidence_text.description: Exact transcript span that justified this interpretation.

utterance_id.description: Stable id for the continuous utterance this cue belongs to. Enables the in-utterance correction override in the director.

created_at.description: Producer clock seconds when the cue was minted. Used by the director to reject cues older than CUE_LIFETIME_S (3s).

mode_revision.description: DirectorSession.mode_revision captured by SemanticQueue at submit time. If the cue arrives after the session's mode_revision has advanced (manual HOLD/RESUME_AUTO/TAKE/SLATE or reconnect), the session rejects it as stale. This is how late AI answers issued before a manual HOLD get dropped.

examples.evidence_text: Sarah joins us after the break.
